topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These remarks introduce the lecture topic on cancer evolution and outline the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how both acquired genetic mutations and non-mutational epigenetic alterations drive clonal selection and tumor initiation.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchies and cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tissue hierarchies and stemness influence the cell of origin and propagation of tumors across different cancers.

topics.label: Role of the microenvironment and inflammation in tumor promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how inflammatory signals and supportive stromal cells in the microenvironment promote tumor growth and provide therapeutic targets.

topics.label: Methodological tools for studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the experimental and computational technologies used to track clonal evolution and cellular interactions within tumor tissues.

topics.label: Multifactorial model of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesises how mutational processes, cellular origins, and microenvironmental conditions interact to drive malignant cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: These closing remarks conclude the session and preview the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
